# RT.ru
> Official Rostelecom website for consumer and business telecom services, digital products, support, and account management in Russia.

The site appears to block access from some VPN connections, but its public structure is well known around Rostelecom’s main service, support, account, and corporate areas. This llms.txt emphasizes stable, high-value pages for product discovery, self-service, and customer support.

## Main
- [Home](https://rt.ru/): Main entry point for Rostelecom consumer and business services.
- [For Home](https://rt.ru/home): Consumer internet, TV, mobile, smart home, and bundled services.
- [For Business](https://rt.ru/b2b): Business connectivity, cloud, security, and digital infrastructure offerings.
- [Support](https://rt.ru/help): Central support area for service questions, troubleshooting, and account help.
- [Personal Account](https://lk.rt.ru/): Customer self-service portal for billing, services, and account management.

## Consumer Services
- [Home Internet](https://rt.ru/home/internet): Residential broadband plans, tariffs, connection options, and availability details.
- [Interactive TV](https://rt.ru/home/tv): Digital television packages, channels, devices, and entertainment features.
- [Mobile Communication](https://rt.ru/home/mobile): Mobile plans, SIM services, tariffs, and bundled offers.
- [Home Phone](https://rt.ru/home/phone): Fixed-line telephony services, tariffs, and connection information.
- [Packages and Bundles](https://rt.ru/home/package): Combined internet, TV, and mobile offers for households.
- [Smart Home](https://rt.ru/home/smarthome): Consumer smart home devices, monitoring, and connected home services.

## Business Services
- [Business Internet](https://rt.ru/b2b/internet): Dedicated and corporate internet connectivity for organizations.
- [Telephony for Business](https://rt.ru/b2b/telephony): Business voice services, SIP, virtual PBX, and communication tools.
- [Cloud Services](https://rt.ru/b2b/cloud): Infrastructure, hosting, and cloud solutions for enterprise workloads.
- [Cybersecurity](https://rt.ru/b2b/security): Security services for networks, endpoints, and corporate infrastructure.
- [Data Centers](https://rt.ru/b2b/dc): Colocation, data center capacity, and infrastructure platform services.
- [Video Surveillance](https://rt.ru/b2b/video): Monitoring and video surveillance solutions for business operations.
- [Industry Solutions](https://rt.ru/b2b/solutions): Vertical digital products for public sector and commercial customers.

## Support and Help
- [Help Center](https://rt.ru/help): Support landing page with common issues and service assistance.
- [Service Payment](https://rt.ru/payment): Online payment options for Rostelecom services and balances.
- [Coverage Check](https://rt.ru/checkconnect): Address-based availability check for connection and service eligibility.
- [Service Status](https://rt.ru/help/service-status): Information about outages, maintenance, and service restoration.
- [FAQ](https://rt.ru/help/faq): Answers to frequent questions about tariffs, equipment, and billing.
- [Contacts](https://rt.ru/contacts): Customer support contacts, hotlines, and regional communication channels.

## Personal Account and Self-Service
- [Personal Account Login](https://lk.rt.ru/): Sign in to manage services, balances, and account settings.
- [Registration](https://lk.rt.ru/#registration): Create a customer account for self-service access.
- [Password Recovery](https://lk.rt.ru/#recovery): Restore access to the personal account.
- [Mobile Personal Account](https://lk.rt.ru/mobile): Mobile-oriented account access for smartphone users.
- [Bonuses and Offers](https://lk.rt.ru/#bonus): View loyalty features, promotions, and personalized offers.

## Products and Devices
- [Equipment](https://rt.ru/home/equipment): Routers, set-top boxes, and related customer premises equipment.
- [Wi‑Fi Solutions](https://rt.ru/home/wifi): Home wireless coverage products and connectivity enhancements.
- [TV Equipment](https://rt.ru/home/tv/equipment): Devices and accessories for interactive television services.
- [SIM and Mobile Devices](https://rt.ru/home/mobile/devices): Mobile-related hardware and device purchase options.
- [Smart Home Devices](https://rt.ru/home/smarthome/devices): Sensors, cameras, and connected home equipment catalog.

## Company and Corporate Information
- [About Company](https://company.rt.ru/): Corporate overview, business profile, and organizational information.
- [Investor Relations](https://company.rt.ru/ir): Financial disclosures, reports, and investor materials.
- [Press Center](https://company.rt.ru/press): News, announcements, and official media publications.
- [Careers](https://company.rt.ru/career): Jobs, internships, and employment information at Rostelecom.
- [Procurement](https://zakupki.rostelecom.ru/): Supplier and procurement portal for tenders and purchasing.
- [Disclosure](https://company.rt.ru/disclosure): Corporate governance and mandatory disclosure materials.

## Legal and Policies
- [Legal Information](https://rt.ru/legal): Legal documents governing services and website usage.
- [Tariffs](https://rt.ru/tariffs): Service tariff information and pricing documentation.
- [Public Offers](https://rt.ru/oferta): Public offer terms and service agreement materials.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rt.ru/privacy): Personal data processing and privacy practices.
- [Personal Data](https://rt.ru/pd): Information related to personal data handling and compliance.
- [Terms of Use](https://rt.ru/rules): Website and service usage rules and conditions.

## Regional Access
- [Regional Selection](https://rt.ru/region): Choose region for localized tariffs, availability, and contacts.
- [Moscow](https://moscow.rt.ru/): Regional Rostelecom portal for Moscow-specific services and offers.
- [Saint Petersburg](https://spb.rt.ru/): Regional portal with local tariffs, support, and connection options.
- [South Region](https://south.rt.ru/): Regional access point for southern Russia services and support.
- [Siberia](https://sib.rt.ru/): Regional portal for Siberian customers and localized service information.
- [Ural](https://ural.rt.ru/): Regional Rostelecom site for Ural-area products and assistance.
